concerns.text: SpyBean mocking with doReturn in TaskReconciliationTest can be brittle in Spring Boot environments; using standard Mockito mocks or explicit test-scoped transactions is preferred.
The use of CURRENT_TIMESTAMP inside @Query updates the database using the database timezone, which might behave differently from LocalDateTime.now() depending on the system/DB configuration.

The dead condition "done".equalsIgnoreCase(targetStatus) in syncTaskStatusesWithGitHub's else block will never be hit since targetStatus is task.getStatus() which is guaranteed not to be "done". This dead code can be removed for clarity.
